SOCIAL LAUNCH COPY

Hydration, in Bloom.

Meet the soft-rose Owala bottle that turns everyday hydration into a small design moment. Its streamlined stainless-steel body slips easily into your routine, while the sculpted lid brings sip options and a built-in carry loop together in one playful silhouette. From desk days to quick dashes out the door, it’s an easy companion with a look that feels calm, polished, and unmistakably yours.

  • Sip your way: The dual-style lid supports different drinking preferences.
  • Carry with ease: The integrated loop gives your fingers a natural grab point.
  • Refill, repeat: The removable lid and straw-ready design simplify everyday use.
